title: Документация хаба: сайт в docs/ корня, страницы umbrella, doctor, профили и примеры, conformance, выпуск, CI; ecosystem и contracts; ADR 0072–0078; CHANGELOG
summary: vitepress-скрипты переезжают из packages/skiller/package.json в docs/package.json, docs.yml — working-directory docs, path_allow снят; новые страницы reference/umbrella, reference/doctor, install-profiles с примерами, reference/conformance, reference/release-bundle, develop (CI-матрица); ecosystem.md и contracts.md — корень хаба и новые контракты; ADR 0072–0078 и индекс; README и getting-started — установка профилями; skill package-architecture — команды umbrella.
why: D24, E45, E16, D76 (сайт хаба); knowledge/hub-p12#docs. Риски: (1) сборка сайта ломается после переезда — npm run docs:build в docs/; (2) skill bootstrap меняется только через канон и генератор, golden skiller-registry.

reads.why: факты кода на начало фазы: файлы, строки, функции

rules: Общие правила фазы — knowledge/hub-p12#rules (stdlib, хаб импортирует только aicore, umbrella без логики модулей и без литералов id, unit/v1 только аддитивно, временные HOME/SKM_HOME, генерируемое — генераторами, английский в продуктовых файлах, быстрые проверки в пункте, широкие — в phase.validation)
Дизайн — раздел knowledge из reads; имена команд, полей, кодов ошибок, путей и форматов — строго оттуда; отклонение или расхождение с кодом — open_issues отчёта (дирижёр пишет plan.py log)
Проекции скиллов и инструкций — только генераторами (skiller registry в песочнице, harness instructions) с golden check
guidance:
Исполнитель: implementation/medium.

Порядок: сайт (docs/package.json, npm ci, docs:build, docs.yml, удаление скриптов из skiller, path_allow) → страницы reference и примеры → ecosystem/contracts → ADR 0072–0078 и индекс → README, getting-started, package-architecture через генератор → CHANGELOG → V1–V4.

validation.cmd: cd docs && npm ci --silent && npm run --silent docs:build
test $(ls docs/architecture/decisions/007[2-8]-*.md | wc -l) -eq 7 && grep -q 0078 docs/architecture/decisions/README.md && ! grep -q '"docs:sync"' packages/skiller/package.json

SB=$(scripts/dev-sandbox.sh new --name p12-skv-$$ | tail -1) && { scripts/dev-sandbox.sh run "$SB" -- bash packages/skiller/scripts/validate.sh; rc=$?; scripts/dev-sandbox.sh remove "$SB" >/dev/null; exit $rc; }
python3 scripts/ecosystem-units.py check && python3 scripts/golden.py check && python3 scripts/public-hygiene.py && python3 scripts/test-docs-impact.py

deliverables: документация umbrella, профилей, conformance, выпуска, CI

result.notes:
Site moved to docs/: docs/package.json plus package-lock.json (copied from skiller's lock with the package name changed), scripts docs:sync/build/dev/preview run in docs/ (vitepress build .), the link-nm script is dropped. skiller keeps only docs:standalone:* and its devDependencies. docs.yml uses working-directory docs and docs/package-lock.json; its paths trigger now watch docs/package*.json. The path_allow entry for packages/skiller/package.json is removed. New pages: reference/umbrella, doctor, conformance, release-bundle, install-profiles, a CI-matrix section in develop.md, and docs/examples/{install-profile-custom.json,extension.json}. ecosystem.md has a hub-root table; contracts.md has rows for plugin-catalog, compat-manifest, umbrella-config, install-profiles and the umbrella output documents, plus the unit/v1 additions. ADR 0072-0078 and the README index are written; sidebar entries for the new pages and ADRs are in the vitepress config. README and getting-started install by profile. The package-architecture canon gained an umbrella section; skiller registry in a sandbox regenerated the .claude and .agents projections and publication-lock.json, and skiller-registry golden was recaptured with a reason. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has an entry. Also run: docs:build (ok), test of V2 expression (ok), ecosystem-units check, public-hygiene, golden check, test-docs-impact (all ok).
Changed: .agents/skills/package-architecture/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/package-architecture/SKILL.md, .github/workflows/docs.yml, CHANGELOG.md, README.md, bootstrap/publication-lock.json, bootstrap/skills/package-architecture/SKILL.md, configs/ecosystem-units.json, docs/.vitepress/config.mts, docs/architecture/contracts.md, docs/architecture/decisions/0072-umbrella-reads-modules-from-unit-json.md, docs/architecture/decisions/0073-doctor-aggregator.md, docs/architecture/decisions/0074-install-profiles.md, docs/architecture/decisions/0075-marketplace-from-unit-json.md, docs/architecture/decisions/0076-conformance-kit.md, docs/architecture/decisions/0077-release-bundle.md, docs/architecture/decisions/0078-installed-form-smoke-and-ci-matrix.md, docs/architecture/decisions/README.md, docs/architecture/ecosystem.md, docs/core/index.md, docs/develop.md, docs/examples/extension.json, docs/examples/install-profile-custom.json, docs/getting-started.md, docs/install-profiles.md, docs/package-lock.json, docs/package.json, docs/reference/conformance.md, docs/reference/doctor.md, docs/reference/release-bundle.md, docs/reference/umbrella.md, packages/skiller/package.json, tests/golden/cases.json, tests/golden/generation.json
deviations: The site build had two dead links that this work exposed. docs/core/index.md linked to packages/aicore/README, which is outside the site; I changed it to plain text. docs/orch/configuration.md is a synced copy of packages/orch/docs/configuration.md, which is outside the write set and links to the module's config.example.toml; I added `ignoreDeadLinks: [/config\.example\.toml$/]` to docs/.vitepress/config.mts instead.

Examples: install has no flag for a custom profiles file, because PROFILES is fixed to configs/install-profiles.json. docs/examples/install-profile-custom.json is therefore a shape example to merge into that file in a checkout, and `--units` and `--option` are given as the per-run alternative. The example is not validated by a command.
